crossRefs.note: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh. He shall make atonement…

translations.web: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.
translations.bsb: This is to be done for each bull, ram, lamb, or goat.
translations.kjv: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
translations.asv: Thus shall it be done for each bullock, or for each ram, or for each of the he-lambs, or of the kids.
